explanation: A period or moment when events occur, the Preacher emphasizes that there is a time for everything in life.
The goal or intention behind something, the Preacher explores humanity's purpose and the meaning of life.
The transience of life and the world, the Preacher stresses that all is fleeting and temporary.
The effort and activities people undertake to achieve a goal, the Preacher reflects on the value and usefulness of labor.
Knowledge and understanding that enable one to make good choices, the Preacher acknowledges the worth of wisdom, yet also its limitations.
A feeling of well-being and contentment, the Preacher seeks joy and meaning in life.
Reverence and awe toward God, the Preacher teaches that this is the foundation of wisdom and the meaning of life.
God's evaluation and justice, the Preacher points out that God will judge all actions, both good and evil.
